# Mample

Mample is a free, open-source notification app for your terminal and AI workflows. Send updates to your Android phone when builds, scripts and AI coding tasks finish. Pair compatible mobile and CLI builds with mample auth qr or manual Secret Key entry. No email/password registration is required; Firebase creates an anonymous session.

## Current scope
- No monthly notification quota, premium tier or subscription.
- Short-term request limits protect against spam.
- Terminal QR pairing is implemented in source: a single-use 90-second invitation leads to a connection without automatic expiry. Compatible mobile, CLI and backend releases are required; source implementation does not imply public package availability.
- The homepage has an official Google Play badge that is inactive until a real store listing is configured. A badge does not establish store publication.
- Browser extensions and browser download notifications are in development. The site retains an extension preview; its source is outside this public release.
- Notification messages are temporarily queued in Firebase. The most recent 200 history entries are stored locally on the phone.
- Optional financial support helps development and server costs; it does not unlock features or usage privileges. The site uses a yellow Support Mample link, with no embedded payment widget.
